title: Planner: Planner Agent chat in basic plans
summary: The briefing's rollout, licensing and documented controls are supported, and it correctly distinguishes the unconfirmed reach of Planner PowerShell into basic-plan chat. Two minor corrections concern the licence-checking checklist item: its supporting reference is missing and it has no corresponding controls-table row.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls: first table row
claims.claim: The general agent block path is Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > All agents > agent > Block > Block agent > Save.
claims.quote: Select Agents > All agents. ... select an agent from the list of agents. ... select Block or Unblock. ... select either Block agent or Unblock agent, and then select Save.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls: first table row
claims.claim: POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block blocks a Copilot package.
claims.quote:
Block a Copilot package to prevent its usage.
POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block

claims.claim: The Graph block operation is a preview beta API.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.claim: The Graph Package Management API requires a Microsoft Agent 365 licence.
claims.quote: Access to the Package Management API requires a Microsoft Agent 365 license.

claims.claim: The cited Graph reference does not state whether Planner Agent is a listed package that it can block.
claims.quote: Searched: "Planner Agent" "catalog" "package" block. Read copilotpackage-block and Package Management API overview excerpts; neither names Planner Agent.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls: second table row
claims.claim: Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $false disables the Planner features within the cited article's stated scope.
claims.quote:
To turn off Planner Agent and Planner Agent chat for all users:
Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $false

claims.where: controls[2].api; Governance controls: third table row
claims.claim: Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $true -PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId <security group id> restricts the documented Planner features to a security group.
claims.quote:
To turn on Planner Agent and Planner Agent chat for a specific security group:
Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $true -PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId <security group id>

claims.claim: The cited Planner Learn page does not describe basic-plan chat processing in detail.

claims.claim: The notice does not describe a separate identity for the chat agent.
claims.quote: Searched: Planner Agent chat basic plans confirm changes approval audit processing identity. Read MC1443514 in full; it specifies users' existing permissions, not a separate agent identity.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Open questions

claims.quote: Searched: Planner Agent chat basic plans confirm changes approval audit processing identity. Read MC1443514, turn-off-planner-agent and release-notes chat excerpts; no per-change confirmation rule. Cowork plugin approval text concerns a different experience.

claims.claim: No dedicated Microsoft Learn page describing Planner Agent chat for basic plans was found.
claims.quote: Searched: "Planner Agent chat" "basic plans" "Learn" documentation; Planner Agent chat basic plans license pricing meter admin UI AllowPlannerCopilot PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId confirmation audit. Read Planner control page and release-note excerpts; no dedicated basic-chat article.

claims.claim: The Planner Learn page describes matching premium-plan auditing as a plan rather than a shipped Planner Agent capability.
claims.quote: Planner Agent plans to provide the same auditing capabilities as premium plans (previously Project for the Web projects).

claims.claim: The 23 September 2026 Copilot release notes list Planner Agent chat under roadmap ID 560532 with this item's description.
claims.quote: September 23, 2026 ... Planner Agent chat [Windows, Web] ... Introducing built-in Planner Agent chat with natural language Q&A, smart task discovery, and in-plan task management. ... Roadmap ID: 560532

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout, licence-checking bullet
claims.claim: Administrators can check users' licence assignments in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: In the admin center, go to the Users > Active users page. ... Select the row of the user ... In the right pane, select Licenses and Apps.
claims.fix: If retaining the licence-checking bullet, add https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/admin/manage/assign-licenses-to-users to sources. Removing the bullet as specified by the checklist finding also resolves this missing citation.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout, licence-checking bullet
claims.claim: The governance checklist tells administrators to check licence assignments, but the controls table has no licence-assignment row.
claims.quote: Confirm which users hold a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence in the Microsoft 365 admin center ... Controls rows cover agent availability, Planner on/off and the allowed security group, not licence assignment.
claims.fix: Remove the first bullet under Governance guidance > Before rollout. The licence requirement is already stated in Cost and licensing and Scope; do not add a control row.
